representation_plans.learner_operation: Identify variables, units, center, spread, and the pattern actually visible in the display.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Provide the same labels and values as an ordered table without adding a trend statement.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Choose or compute the descriptive feature that answers the stated question.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State every plotted or tabulated value and its unit in reading order without computing the answer.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Decide whether variation scatters repeated values or shifts them together, then state the resulting uncertainty.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List target value, repeated measurements, and shared calibration conditions without resolving the error type.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Interpret uncertainty and significance only at the level licensed by the supplied interval information.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State each estimate and interval endpoint in an ordered table without announcing a comparison verdict.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Link each conclusion clause to a displayed result and flag clauses with no supporting observation.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List observed results, candidate conclusions, and plausible alternatives in separate labeled sections.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Choose the strongest conclusion for which every clause has evidence.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State all result values and conclusion options without ranking or highlighting them.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Carry a pattern forward only to a specified repeat or changed condition and state what remains uncertain.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List observed conditions, pattern direction, and proposed new condition without extending the trend.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Select the implication that preserves the observed relation and respects the new condition.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State observed and changed-condition values in separate labeled blocks without supplying the prediction.
